## Common JOIN Patterns

### 店铺-店主映射 (Credit/Deduction 流水场景)

```sql
-- 构建 shop_id ↔ user_id 映射表
CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW dim_common_shop_latest_reg_s0_live AS
SELECT *
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_common_shop__reg_s0_live
WHERE dt = "${yesterday}";

CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW ads_shop AS
SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, user_id
FROM (
    SELECT shop_id, user_id FROM dim_common_shop_latest_reg_s0_live
    UNION
    SELECT shop_id, user_id FROM ads_credit
);
```

### 店铺元信息增强 (Ads Tracking JOIN)

```sql
-- LEFT JOIN 维表获取店铺 sold_cnt 和 create_timestamp
SELECT
    A.shopid AS shopid,
    B.sold_total_cnt AS sold_cnt,
    A.country,
    CASE WHEN DATE(substr(from_unixtime(B.create_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), 1, 10)) < DATE('2022-12-20')
         THEN 'mature_shop' ELSE 'coldstart_shop' END AS shop_type
FROM mkplpaidads_data.ads_tracking A
LEFT JOIN mkplpaidads_data.dim_common_shop__reg_s0_live B
    ON A.shopid = B.shop_id AND A.country = B.grass_region
WHERE A.dt = '2023-01-03'
  AND B.dt = '2023-01-03'
  AND A.ads_placement IN (5, 805)
  AND A.country IN ('BR', 'ID', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'MY')
```

### 广告-店铺关联 (Brand Ads)

```sql
-- JOIN dim_advertise 获取活跃且有店铺的广告
SELECT DISTINCT T0.shop_id
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, grass_region
    FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE'2023-05-28'
      AND placement = 3
      AND grass_region = 'TW'
      AND tz_type = 'local'
      AND ads_status = 1
) T0
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, grass_region
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_common_shop_latest__reg_s0_live
    WHERE dt = '2023-05-28'
      AND status = 1
      AND grass_region = 'TW'
) T1
ON T0.shop_id = T1.shop_id AND T0.grass_region = T1.grass_region
```

## Common Aggregations

### 店铺状态统计

```sql
-- 按 shop_id 统计记录数(对维表通常 COUNT 可通用)
SELECT COUNT(1) AS c
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_common_shop__reg_s0_live
WHERE dt = '2022-07-17'
GROUP BY shop_id
ORDER BY c
```

### 冷启动/成熟店铺分层

```sql
-- 基于 create_timestamp 对店铺分层
SELECT
    country, shop_type,
    COUNT(shopid) AS shop_count,
    APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT(shopid) AS dist_shop_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        A.shopid AS shopid,
        A.country,
        CASE WHEN DATE(substr(from_unixtime(B.create_timestamp, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), 1, 10)) < DATE('2022-12-20')
             THEN 'mature_shop' ELSE 'coldstart_shop' END AS shop_type
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.ads_tracking A
    LEFT JOIN mkplpaidads_data.dim_common_shop__reg_s0_live B
        ON A.shopid = B.shop_id AND A.country = B.grass_region
    WHERE A.dt = '2023-01-03' AND B.dt = '2023-01-03'
) t
GROUP BY country, shop_type
```

### Snippet 3: 活跃投放店铺筛选

```sql
-- 筛选出在广告投放且活跃的店铺
SELECT T0.shop_id
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, grass_region
    FROM mp_paidads.dim_advertise__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE'{args.end_date}'
      AND placement = 3
      AND grass_region = '{args.country}'
      AND tz_type = 'local'
      AND ads_status = 1
) T0
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT shop_id, grass_region
    FROM mkplpaidads_data.dim_common_shop_latest__reg_s0_live
    WHERE dt = DATE'{args.end_date}'
      AND status = 1
      AND grass_region = '{args.country}'
) T1
ON T0.shop_id = T1.shop_id AND T0.grass_region = T1.grass_region
LIMIT 100
```
